title.en: Declaring the Lease-Sale of One L-100-20 Hercules Aircraft No. PI 98, a Government Property, as a Valid and Binding Contract of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines and Creating a Special Fund From Theproceeds Thereof.

text.en:
Existing laws, orders, decrees, rules and regulations to the contrary notwithstanding, the
agreement entered into by the Republic of the Philippines, through its duly authorized representative, on July
16, 1973 for the lease, with an option to purchase, of its aircrafts, No. PI 98, to James Bay Energy
Corporation, a body politic incorporated under the laws of Quebec, Canada, is hereby declared a valid and
binding contract of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines.

A Special Fund is hereby constituted out of the proceeds of the lease-sale agreement for the
following purposes:
(1) To finance partly the initial government acquisition of helicopters from the Federal Republic of Germany
in conformity with the Progressive Helicopter Assembly and Manufacturing Program and/or expenditures for
activities related thereto; and
(2) To finance the prepayment to the Export-Import Bank of the United States of that portion of an existing
loan covering subject aircraft, which shall be made as soon thereafter as title to said aircraft passes to James
Bay Energy Corporation on June 1, 1977.
The Fund shall be administered and accounted for by the Development Management Staff, Office of the
President, as the owner-agency of the Hercules aircraft, and expenditures therefrom shall be made subject to
the approval of the Executive Secretary.

This decree shall take effect upon approval.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
